corpus: full final text from earlier sessions, combining human prose and accepted model insertions
finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Both interval methods exclude the useful margin against base, pooled, donor and uniform; all primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor useful advantage is excluded under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed resampling; pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both, with all residual intervals including zero. Raw sums exclude useful base advantage under both methods and retain useful pooled and donor uncertainty under both, with all model-rival intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Mixed human/model provenance, sparse histories, transferred calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, human-only language-learning claim, epoch/corpus ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
